name: Elixir of Agony
summary: In the Undercity, Faranell prepares Lydon's mixture for a deadly purpose. The Royal Apothecary Society needs reagents from the coast and alchemical draughts to make its new plague ready.

sections.title: A Colloid of Decay
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon sent his Mudsnout Blossom mixture from gnoll-held Nethander Stead to the Apothecarium in the Undercity. Master Apothecary Faranell leads the Royal Apothecary Society, and he saw the mixture's grim potential at once. Its toxic properties pleased him, so he added his own colloid of decay. Then he named the catalysts that could turn it into a weapon.

sections.title: Catalysts from the Coast
sections.body: To activate the mixture's contaminating agents, Lydon needs exact reagents in Tarren Mill. Faranell calls for a restorative draught of Strong Troll's Blood to feed and steady the chemical reaction. He also needs organic parts from Hillsbrad's southern shore: scales from the serpentine Daggerspine naga and eyes from the coastal Torn Fin murlocs.

sections.title: Cruelty in Tarren Mill
sections.body: Back in Tarren Mill, Lydon spends the waiting hours poisoning and infecting his undead test subject, Umpi, then bringing her back to life. Faranell's enriched mixture and the coastal catalysts bring Lydon closer to perfecting an agonizing new strain of blight for Hillsbrad's living settlements.

faq.q: Why does the plague require a restorative troll's blood elixir?
faq.answer: Restorative Strong Troll's Blood sustains and fuels aggressive biological agents, helping them mutate rapidly. Its properties keep the toxic cultures thriving long enough to react with the other tissues.

faq.q: Where are the Daggerspine scales found?
faq.answer: Daggerspine scales come from hostile naga on Hillsbrad's eastern beaches, along the shore east of Southshore.

faq.q: Where are the Torn Fin eyes obtained?
faq.answer: Torn Fin eyes come from murloc tribes on Hillsbrad's western coast, just west of Southshore.
Umpi is the frog Apothecary Lydon keeps as his assistant in Tarren Mill. In his idle hours, Lydon tests lethal toxins and diseases on her, then brings her back to life.

faq.q: Why is Master Apothecary Faranell involved in this local project?
faq.answer: Master Apothecary Faranell leads the Royal Apothecary Society and oversees research into biological agents and plagues. Field apothecaries such as Lydon send promising discoveries to Faranell in the Undercity for refinement and authorization.

Lydon's Mudsnout Mixture is an unrefined toxic blend made from Mudsnout Blossoms, foul mushrooms gathered at gnoll-infested Nethander Stead in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Seeing its unusual virulence, Lydon sent it to the Undercity, where Faranell added decayed colloids to make a deadlier contagion.

angles.text: Each refined reagent brings the Royal Apothecary Society closer to fulfilling Lady Sylvanas's desire for an ultimate weapon against the living.
Tarren Mill faces constant border skirmishes with the Alliance of Southshore. Lydon's toxic experiments aim to tip the regional balance of power.
